test_generalized_iterators: test pybind11 generalized iterators by filtering nonzero pairs and extracting keys from IntPairs objects
test_sliceable: test pybind11 sliceable objects by slicing with start, stop, and step parameters on a Sliceable instance
test_sequence: test pybind11 sequence protocol by creating, indexing, reversing, and slice-assigning a Sequence object
test_python_iterator_in_cpp: test passing Python iterators to C++ functions like object_to_list and iterator_to_list via pybind11
test_iterator_passthrough: test pybind11 iterator passthrough by passing a Python iterator through C++ and verifying values
